import re
import sys

assignment = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[a-p]|-?\d+)\s*;\s*(?://.*)?$"
)
values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.match(line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        values[target] = int(source) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", source) else values[source]

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
